p.i: The words which Alma, the high priest according to the Holy Order of God, delivered to the people in their cities and villages throughout the land.

chapter.li: LEChapter5 Verse1 Now it came to pass that Alma began to declare the word of God unto the people, first in the land of Zarahemla, and from thence throughout all the land. VerseEnd Verse2 And these are the words which he spake to the people in the church which were established in the city of Zarahemla, according to his own record, saying, VerseEnd Verse3 I, Alma, having been consecrated by my father Alma to be a high priest over the church of God — he having power and authority from God to do these things — behold, I say unto 2PP you that he began to establish a church in the land which was in the borders of Nephi — yea, the land was called the land of Mormon — yea, and he did baptize his brethren in the waters of Mormon. VerseEnd Verse4 And behold, I say unto 2PP you, they were delivered out of the hands of the people of king Noah by the mercy and power of God. VerseEnd Verse5 And behold, after that, they were brought into bondage by the hands of the Lamanites in the wilderness. Yea, I say unto 2PP you, they were in captivity, and again the Lord did deliver them out of bondage by the power of his word. And we were brought into this land, and here we began to establish the church of God throughout this land also. VerseEnd

Verse6 And now behold, I say unto 2PP you, my brethren, 2PP you that belong to this church, have 2PP you sufficiently retained in remembrance the captivity of 2PP your fathers? Yea, and have 2PP you sufficiently retained in remembrance his mercy and long-suffering towards them? And moreover, have 2PP ye sufficiently retained in remembrance that he has delivered their souls from hell? VerseEnd Verse7 Behold, he changed their hearts; yea, he awaked them out of a deep sleep, and they awake unto God. Behold, they were in the midst of darkness; nevertheless, their souls were illuminated by the light of the everlasting word. Yea, they were encircled about by the bands of death and the chains of hell, and an everlasting destruction did await them. VerseEnd Verse8 And now I ask of 2PP you, my brethren, were they destroyed? Behold, I say unto 2PP you, nay, they were not. VerseEnd Verse9 And again I ask, were the bands of death broken? And the chains of hell which encircled them about, were they loosed? I say unto 2PP you, yea, they were loosed. And their souls did expand, and they did sing redeeming love. And I say unto 2PP you that they are saved. VerseEnd Verse10 And now I ask of 2PP you, on what conditions are they saved? Yea, what grounds had they to hope for salvation? What is the cause of their being loosed from the bands of death, yea, and also the chains of hell? VerseEnd Verse11 Behold, I can tell 2PP you. Did not my father Alma believe in the words which were delivered by the mouth of Abinadi? And was he not a holy prophet? Did he not speak the words of God? And my father Alma believed them. VerseEnd Verse12 And according to his faith, there was a mighty change wrought in his heart. Behold, I say unto 2PP you that this is all true. VerseEnd Verse13 And behold, he preached the word unto 2PP your fathers, and a mighty change was also wrought in their hearts, and they humbled themselves and put their trust in the true and living God. And behold, they were faithful until the end; therefore, they were saved. VerseEnd

Verse14 And now behold, I ask of 2PP you, my brethren of the church, have 2PP ye spiritually been born of God? Have 2PP ye received his image in 2PP your own countenances? Have 2PP ye experienced this mighty change in 2PP your hearts? VerseEnd Verse15 Do 2PP ye exercise faith in the redemption of him who created 2PP you? Do 2PP you look forward with an eye of faith and view this mortal body raised in immortality, and this corruption raised in incorruption? To stand before God to be judged according to the deeds which have been done in the mortal body? VerseEnd Verse16 I say unto 2PP you, can 2PP you imagine to yourselves that 2PP ye hear the voice of the Lord saying unto 2PP you in that day, Come unto me, 2PP ye blessed, for behold, 2PP your works have been the works of righteousness upon the face of the earth — VerseEnd Verse17 or do 2PP ye imagine to yourselves that 2PP ye can lie unto the Lord at that day and say, Lord, our works have been righteous works upon the face of the earth — and that he will save 2PP you? VerseEnd Verse18 Or otherwise, can 2PP ye imagine yourselves brought before the tribunal of God with 2PP your souls filled with guilt and remorse, having a remembrance of all 2PP your guilt, yea, a perfect remembrance of all 2PP your wickedness, yea, a remembrance that 2PP ye have set at defiance the commandments of God? VerseEnd Verse19 I say unto 2PP you, can 2PP ye look up to God at that day with a pure heart and clean hands? I say unto 2PP you, can 2PP you look up, having the image of God engraven upon 2PP your countenances? VerseEnd Verse20 I say unto 2PP you, can 2PP ye think of being saved when 2PP you have yielded yourselves to become subjects to the Devil? VerseEnd Verse21 I say unto 2PP you, 2PP ye will know at that day that 2PP ye cannot be saved; for there can no man be saved except his garments are washed white. Yea, his garments must be purified until they are cleansed from all stain through the blood of him of whom it has been spoken by our fathers, who should come to redeem his people from their sins. VerseEnd

Verse22 And now I ask of 2PP you, my brethren, how will any of 2PP you feel if 2PP ye shall stand before the bar of God, having 2PP your garments stained with blood and all manner of filthiness? Behold, what will these things testify against 2PP you? VerseEnd Verse23 Behold, will they not testify that 2PP ye are murderers? Yea, and also that 2PP ye are guilty of all manner of wickedness? VerseEnd Verse24 Behold, my brethren, do 2PP ye suppose that such an one can have a place to sit down in the kingdom of God with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob, and also all the holy prophets whose garments are cleansed and are spotless, pure, and white? VerseEnd Verse25 I say unto 2PP you, nay, except 2PP ye make our Creator a liar from the beginning, or suppose that he is a liar from the beginning. 2PP Ye cannot suppose that such can have place in the kingdom of Heaven, but he shall be cast out, for they are the children of the kingdom of the Devil. VerseEnd

Verse26 And now behold, I say unto 2PP you, my brethren, if 2PP ye have experienced a change of heart, and if 2PP ye have felt to sing the song of redeeming love, I would ask, can 2PP ye feel so now? VerseEnd Verse27 Have 2PP ye walked keeping yourselves blameless before God? Could 2PP ye say — if 2PP ye were called to die at this time — within yourselves that 2PP ye have been sufficiently humble, that 2PP your garments have been cleansed and made white through the blood of Christ, who will come to redeem his people from their sins? VerseEnd Verse28 Behold, are 2PP ye stripped of pride? I say unto 2PP you, if 2PP ye are not, 2PP ye are not prepared to meet God. Behold, 2PP ye must prepare quickly; for the kingdom of Heaven is soon at hand, and such an one hath not eternal life. VerseEnd Verse29 Behold, I say, is there one among 2PP you who is not stripped of envy? I say unto 2PP you that such an one is not prepared. And I would that he should prepare quickly, for the hour is close at hand; and he knoweth not when the time shall come, for such an one is not found guiltless. VerseEnd

Verse30 And again I say unto 2PP you, is there one among 2PP you that doth make a mock of his brother or that heapeth upon him persecutions? VerseEnd Verse31 Woe unto such an one, for he is not prepared; and the time is at hand that he must repent, or he cannot be saved. VerseEnd Verse32 Yea, even woe unto all 2PP ye workers of iniquity. Repent, repent, for the Lord God hath spoken it. VerseEnd Verse33 Behold, he sendeth an invitation unto all men; for the arms of mercy are extended towards them, and he saith, Repent and I will receive 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse34 Yea, he saith, Come unto me and 2PP ye shall partake of the fruit of the tree of life; yea, 2PP ye shall eat and drink of the bread and the waters of life freely. VerseEnd Verse35 Yea, come unto me and bring forth works of righteousness, and 2PP ye shall not be put down and cast into the fire. VerseEnd Verse36 For behold, the time is at hand that whosoever bringeth forth not good fruit, or whosoever doeth not the works of righteousness, the same have cause to wail and mourn. VerseEnd

Verse37 O 2PP ye workers of iniquity, 2PP ye that are puffed up in the vain things of the world, 2PP ye that have professed to have known the ways of righteousness — nevertheless, 2PP ye have gone astray as sheep having no shepherd, notwithstanding a shepherd hath called after 2PP you, and art still calling after 2PP you, but 2PP ye will not hearken unto his voice. VerseEnd Verse38 Behold, I say unto 2PP you that the Good Shepherd doth call 2PP you; yea, and in his own name he doth call 2PP you, which is the name of Christ. And if 2PP ye will not hearken unto the voice of the good shepherd, to the name by which 2PP ye are called, behold, 2PP ye are not the sheep of the good shepherd. VerseEnd Verse39 And now if 2PP ye are not the sheep of the good shepherd, of what fold are 2PP ye? Behold, I say unto 2PP you that the Devil is 2PP your shepherd, and 2PP ye are of his fold. And now who can deny this? Behold, I say unto 2PP you, whosoever denieth this is a liar and a child of the Devil. VerseEnd

Verse40 For I say unto 2PP you that whatsoever is good cometh from God, and whatsoever is evil cometh from the Devil. VerseEnd Verse41 Therefore, if a man bringeth forth good works, he hearkeneth unto the voice of the good shepherd, and he doth follow him. But whosoever bringeth forth evil works, the same becometh a child of the Devil, for he hearkeneth unto his voice and doth follow him. VerseEnd Verse42 And whosoever doeth this must receive his wages of him. Therefore, for his wages he receiveth death as to things pertaining unto righteousness, being dead unto all good works. VerseEnd Verse43 And now, my brethren, I would that 2PP ye should hear me, for I speak in the energy of my soul. For behold, I have spoken unto 2PP you plain, that 2PP ye cannot err, or have spoken according to the commandments of God. VerseEnd Verse44 For I am called to speak after this manner, according to the Holy Order of God, which is in Christ Jesus. Yea, I am commanded to stand and testify unto this people the things which have been spoken by our fathers concerning the things which are to come. VerseEnd Verse45 And this is not all; do 2PP ye not suppose that I know of these things myself? Behold, I testify unto 2PP you that I do know that these things whereof I have spoken are true. And how do 2PP ye suppose that I know of their surety? VerseEnd Verse46 Behold, I say unto 2PP you, they are made known unto me by the holy spirit of God. Behold, I have fasted and prayed many days that I might know these things of myself. And now I do know of myself that they are true, for the Lord God hath made them manifest unto me by his holy spirit; and this is the spirit of revelation which is in me. VerseEnd Verse47 And moreover, I say unto 2PP you that as it has thus been revealed unto me that the words which have been spoken by our fathers are true, even so according to the spirit of prophecy which is in me, which is also by the manifestation of the spirit of God, VerseEnd Verse48 I say unto 2PP you that I know of myself that whatsoever I shall say unto 2PP you concerning that which is to come is true. And I say unto 2PP you that I know that Jesus Christ shall come, yea, the Son, the Only Begotten of the Father, full of grace, and mercy, and truth. And behold, it is he that cometh to take away the sins of the world, yea, the sins of every man who steadfastly believeth on his name. VerseEnd

Verse49 And now I say unto 2PP you that this is the Order after which I am called, yea, to preach unto my beloved brethren, yea, and everyone that dwelleth in the land — yea, to preach unto all, both old and young, both bond and free, yea, I say unto 2PP you, the aged, and also the middle-aged, and the rising generation — yea, to cry unto them that they must repent and be born again. VerseEnd Verse50 Yea, thus saith the spirit: Repent, all 2PP ye ends of the earth, for the kingdom of Heaven is soon at hand. Yea, the Son of God cometh in his glory, in his might, majesty, power, and dominion. Yea, my beloved brethren, I say unto 2PP you that the spirit saith, Behold, the glory of the King of all the earth and also the King of Heaven shall very soon shine forth among all the children of men. VerseEnd Verse51 And also the spirit saith unto me, yea, crieth unto me with a mighty voice, saying, Go forth and say unto this people, Repent, for except 2PP ye repent, 2PP ye can in nowise inherit the kingdom of Heaven. VerseEnd Verse52 And again I say unto 2PP you, the spirit saith, Behold, the ax is laid at the root of the tree; therefore, every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit shall be hewn down and cast into the fire, yea, a fire which cannot be consumed, even an unquenchable fire. Behold, and remember, the Holy One hath spoken it. VerseEnd

Verse53 And now, my beloved brethren, I say unto 2PP you, can 2PP ye withstand these sayings? Yea, can 2PP ye lay aside these things and trample the Holy One under 2PP your feet? Yea, can 2PP ye be puffed up in the pride of 2PP your hearts? Yea, will 2PP ye still persist in the wearing of costly apparel and setting 2PP your hearts upon the vain things of the world? Upon 2PP your riches? VerseEnd Verse54 Yea, will 2PP ye persist in supposing that 2PP ye are better one than another? Yea, will 2PP ye persist in the persecutions of 2PP your brethren who humble themselves and do walk after the Holy Order of God wherewith they have been brought into this church, having been sanctified by the holy spirit? And they do bring forth works which are meet for repentance. VerseEnd Verse55 Yea, and will 2PP you persist in turning 2PP your backs upon the poor and the needy? And in withholding 2PP your substance from them? VerseEnd Verse56 And finally, all 2PP ye that will persist in 2PP your wickedness, I say unto 2PP you that these are those who shall be hewn down and cast into the fire, except they speedily repent. VerseEnd

Verse57 And now I say unto 2PP you, all 2PP you that are desirous to follow the voice of the good shepherd, come 2PP ye out from the wicked and be 2PP ye separate, and touch not their unclean things. And behold, their names shall be blotted out, that the names of the wicked shall not be numbered among the names of the righteous, that the word of God may be fulfilled which saith, The names of the wicked shall not be mingled with the names of my people, VerseEnd Verse58 for the names of the righteous shall be written in the Book of Life, and unto them will I grant an inheritance at my right hand. And now, my brethren, what have 2PP ye to say against this? I say unto 2PP you, if 2PP ye speak against it, it matters not, for the word of God must be fulfilled. VerseEnd Verse59 For what shepherd is there among 2PP you, having many sheep, doth not watch over them that the wolves enter not and devour his flock? And behold, if a wolf enter his flock, doth he not drive him out? Yea, and at the last, if he can, he will destroy him. VerseEnd Verse60 And now I say unto 2PP you that the good shepherd doth call after 2PP you. And if 2PP you will hearken unto his voice, he will bring 2PP you into his fold and 2PP ye are his sheep. And he commandeth 2PP you that 2PP ye suffer no ravenous wolf to enter among 2PP you, that 2PP ye may not be destroyed. VerseEnd

Verse61 And now I, Alma, do command 2PP you in the language of him who hath commanded me that 2PP ye observe to do the words which I have spoken unto 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse62 I speak by way of command unto 2PP you that belong to the church. And unto those who do not belong to the church, I speak by way of invitation, saying, Come and be baptized unto repentance, that 2PP ye also may be partakers of the fruit of the tree of life. VerseEnd
